body: Generation now automatically runs pinned worldbridge, validates output, and publishes a hash-bound diagnostic heightfield pointer. Harness verifies both seeds, cancellation preserving prior pointer, and both binary hash refusals. In-game PID30776 seed42 generation plus extraction succeeded (reader 5616ms). Calibration grid initialized then crashed, and PID4528 smaller collision batches also crashed after first scene tick before measurements. Both prompts dismissed via activation + Alt+N and exit verified. No full-grid rendering accepted. Next controlled comparison switches input to scene-layer context used by successful quad test, adding before/after input traces. Evidence: generator-reader-harness.json; generation-with-reader-30776-42.json; calibration-crash-30776/4528.json. Epic remains incomplete.
